q: 近6个月每月产奶量趋势
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.record_date, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, ROUND(SUM(m.milk_yield), 2) AS 产奶量 FROM dwh_fact_milk m LEFT JOIN dwh_dim_cattle c ON m.cattle_id = c.id LEFT JOIN dwh_dim_farm f ON m.farm_id = f.id WHERE m.record_date >= '2026-05-01' AND m.record_date < '2026-10-07' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(m.record_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY 月份 LIMIT 12

q: 近7天每天产奶量
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.record_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS 日期, ROUND(SUM(m.milk_yield), 2) AS 产奶量 FROM dwh_fact_milk m LEFT JOIN dwh_dim_cattle c ON m.cattle_id = c.id LEFT JOIN dwh_dim_farm f ON m.farm_id = f.id WHERE m.record_date >= '2026-09-30' AND m.record_date < '2026-10-07' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(m.record_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY 日期 LIMIT 31

q: 今年各季度的产奶量
sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(m.record_date), '-Q', QUARTER(m.record_date)) AS 季度, ROUND(SUM(m.milk_yield), 2) AS 产奶量 FROM dwh_fact_milk m LEFT JOIN dwh_dim_cattle c ON m.cattle_id = c.id LEFT JOIN dwh_dim_farm f ON m.farm_id = f.id WHERE m.record_date >= '2026-01-01' AND m.record_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY CONCAT(YEAR(m.record_date), '-Q', QUARTER(m.record_date)) ORDER BY 季度 LIMIT 12
